items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: And we became great friends through the year. I arranged for him.

ctx.x: Yeah, the pit and come up there and take his watch out and look at the time and then he'd sit down and put his hands over the -- he'd stretch his fingers and then he'd start playing. I used to say that's wonderful. And we became great friends through the year. I arranged for him. He's got a number down in this show, Eubie, that I arranged. Two or three of them in this show. Get it. Have you seen the show.
No, I didn't get a chance to see the show yet, but do you remember the numbers that you arranged for, what were they.
